# config.schema { #keecas.config.schema }

`schema`

Configuration schema definitions and version registry for keecas.

Manages schema versions, deprecated keys, renamed keys, and migration functions
to handle breaking configuration changes across package versions.

## Classes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [ConfigSchema](#keecas.config.schema.ConfigSchema) | Schema definition for a specific config version. |

### ConfigSchema { #keecas.config.schema.ConfigSchema }

```python
ConfigSchema(
    version,
    created_at,
    deprecated_keys,
    renamed_keys,
    removed_keys,
    migration_fn,
)
```

Schema definition for a specific config version.

## Functions

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [migrate_0_1_to_1_0](#keecas.config.schema.migrate_0_1_to_1_0) | Migrate config from 0.1.x to 1.0.0 |
| [get_current_schema_version](#keecas.config.schema.get_current_schema_version) | Get the current/latest schema version. |
| [get_schema](#keecas.config.schema.get_schema) | Get schema definition for a specific version. |

### migrate_0_1_to_1_0 { #keecas.config.schema.migrate_0_1_to_1_0 }

```python
migrate_0_1_to_1_0(old_config)
```

Migrate config from 0.1.x to 1.0.0

IMPORTANT: All user-customized values MUST be preserved during migration.
Only transform structure/location, never lose user data.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type           | Description                    | Default    |
|------------|----------------|--------------------------------|------------|
| old_config | [dict](`dict`) | Configuration dict from v0.1.x | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description                            |
|--------|----------------|----------------------------------------|
|        | [dict](`dict`) | Migrated configuration dict for v1.0.0 |
